meta: A secure, reliable home for your app on AWS, Google Cloud, Azure or a simple host. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Cloud hosting setup, secure from day one
overview: We set up the place your product lives in your own cloud account, on AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, DigitalOcean or a simpler host that suits your size. We choose a sensible server or container set-up, add a database, storage, a firewall, HTTPS and basic alerts, and deploy your app to it. You get an account you own, a one-page diagram and notes for whoever manages it next.

A scalable set-up with load balancer, backups and code-defined setup.

faq: Which cloud providers do you use?
AWS, Google Cloud, Azure and DigitalOcean are the usual choices, and we also set up simpler hosts. We recommend one based on your app, budget and team, and explain why in plain words before we begin.
Yes. We set everything up inside your own cloud account, so you keep full control and can add or remove people at any time. We never ask for your password. You add us as a team member.
Can you host WordPress or Shopify apps?
WordPress, Node, Python, PHP and container apps are all fine. Shopify and Wix stores are hosted by those companies, so they do not need this service. Tell us what you run and we confirm fit.
You do, directly to the cloud provider. Our price covers the set-up work only. We give you a monthly cost estimate before building, so there are no surprises on your first bill.
